description: Measured binding affinities (Ki, Kd, IC50, EC50 in nM) for every ligand BindingDB has curated against a UniProt target, each with the PubMed ID of the paper it was measured in. AUTHORITATIVE for "what compounds bind this protein and how tightly" — this is experimental medicinal-chemistry data, not a prediction or a web summary. Pass one or more UniProt accessions (e.g. P24941 for CDK2).

cutoff.description: Affinity cutoff in nM — only measurements at or below this are returned. Default 10. Raising it enlarges the upstream response substantially (100 nM on a well-studied kinase is several MB).

limit.description: Max rows to return, 1-500 (default 50). Sorted by potency.

uniprot.description: UniProt accession, or several comma-separated (e.g. "P24941" or "P24941,P00533")

name: bindingdb_ligands_by_uniprot
title: Bindingdb Ligands By Uniprot
